intermediate.name: 1st passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (160.2 km)

story: The initial breakaway was quickly caught. At 35 km from the finish, del Toro launched an attack, with only Pellizzari able to follow. The duo gained a significant lead, and the peloton could not close the gap. Pellizzari won the stage, while del Toro became the new overall leader.
